parameters.query:
INSERT INTO trending_videos (run_id, rank, video_id, title, author, views, likes, hashtags, category, thumbnail_url, tiktok_url, scraped_at)
VALUES (
  COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM workflow_runs), 1),
  {{ $json.rank }},
  '{{ $json.video_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.author.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.views }}',
  '{{ $json.likes }}',
  ARRAY[{{ $json.hashtags.map(h => "'" + h.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  '{{ $json.category.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.thumbnail_url }}',
  '{{ $json.tiktok_url }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (video_id) DO UPDATE
  SET views = EXCLUDED.views, likes = EXCLUDED.likes, thumbnail_url = EXCLUDED.thumbnail_url, scraped_at = NOW();

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'scraped', message: 'Instagram trending saved to DB' }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO creator_sessions (session_id, creator_id, selected_video_id, niche, user_prompt, status, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.creatorId }}_ig_{{ $now.toMillis() }}',
  '{{ $json.creatorId }}',
  '{{ $json.selectedVideoId }}',
  '{{ $json.niche }}',
  '{{ $json.userPrompt.replace("'", "''") }}',
  'script_generation',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id, session_id, creator_id, niche, selected_video_id, user_prompt;

SELECT tv.title, tv.author, tv.views, tv.likes, tv.hashtags, tv.category
FROM trending_videos tv
WHERE tv.video_id = '{{ $json.selected_video_id }}'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.text:
=You are a viral Instagram Reels scriptwriter and creative director.

A creator has selected this TRENDING POST as inspiration:
{{ $json.videoContext }}

Niche: **{{ $json.niche }}**
Style: {{ $json.style }}

{{ $json.userPrompt ? "Creator's specific angle: " + $json.userPrompt : '' }}

Your job: write an ORIGINAL 15-30 second Instagram Reel script that is INSPIRED by the above post. Borrow its energy, hook style, and what made it go viral. Make it fresh and engaging.

Provide your response as a JSON object with these fields:
- hook: A punchy opening line (2 seconds)
- middle: The main body of the script
- cta: A strong call-to-action
- visual_directions: Brief visual direction notes
- music_vibe: Suggested music mood
- hashtags: Array of 5-8 relevant hashtags (include #)
- full_script: The complete spoken script

Output ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no explanation.

)
RETURNING id;

parameters.query:
SELECT gs.script_json, gs.script_content FROM generated_scripts gs
WHERE gs.session_id = '{{ $json.session_id }}'
AND gs.status = 'approved'
ORDER BY gs.created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
